newsitem.title: FINLAND: TIMETABLE FOR U.S.-RUSSIA HELSINKI SUMMIT.
newsitem.headline: TIMETABLE FOR U.S.-RUSSIA HELSINKI SUMMIT.

text.p: Following is the planned
timetable for this week's summit between U.S. President Bill
Clinton and Russian President Boris Yeltsin.
The summit in the Finnish capital will start on Thursday,
one day later than planned because Clinton had to undergo
surgery following a knee injury last week. The main talks take
place on Friday.
All times given are local, followed by GMT. THURSDAY MARCH
1200/1000 GMT - Clinton arrives in Helsinki.
1445/1245 GMT - Yeltsin arrives.
Early evening - Clinton and Finnish President Martti
Ahtisaari hold bilateral meeting at presidential palace.
1900/1700 GMT - The summit officially starts with a dinner
hosted by President Ahtisaari and a separate meeting between
Yeltsin and Clinton.
FRIDAY MARCH 21
Early morning - Ahtisaari greets both presidents at his
secluded residence, Mantyniemi, and leaves them to their talks.
The house is on a promontory overlooking the Baltic.
Early evening - A news conference is planned at the nearby
Kalastajatorppa Hotel, close to the summit site.
2200/2000 GMT - Clinton leaves for Washington.
SATURDAY MARCH 22
Yeltsin and Ahtisaari have bilateral talks over lunch at
Presidential Palace. A news conference is planned to follow.
1500/1300 GMT - Yeltsin leaves for Moscow.
1600/1400 GMT - Ahtisaari holds news conference marking end
of summit.
